blockers.description: Non-vacuous uniform Prop 4.3 'not' case needs a model-independent arity-m negation with a uniform correctness iff = the model-INDEP Prop 4.2 backward, proved UNFIXABLE at the BracketFormula level (report 18, NegationIndep.lean:331-351). neg_vec_ea_m (Phase 4a) is only the model-dependent existential and cannot yield a uniform function.

Non-vacuous uniform Prop 4.3 'and' case needs a COMPLETE arity-m conjunction closure (Lemma 3.2(1) as an iff). VVecEA_m.conj is sound but not complete: conjStruct discards one conjunct's interval segments when both carry witnesses (VecEAClosure.lean:163-169), so conj_holds is forward-only.

Non-vacuous uniform Prop 4.3 'all'/'ex' cases need Lemma 3.4 (arbitrary-position existential/universal closure). existClosure (VecEA_m.lean:208) absorbs only the rightmost free variable under StrictMono(extendEnv env z); the De Bruijn .ex/.all binder prepends an order-unconstrained witness at index 0 (MonadicFO.lean:222-223). No re-indexing bridges these (the orders genuinely differ); needs a witness-position split + variable reordering + a leftward existClosure. Even live KampPrior:391 (n=1) needs both leftward and rightward absorption.

ROOT framing blocker: the per-model existential statement (exists v, v.holds env iff eval phi), the codebase convention from neg_2var_vec_ea/neg_vec_ea_m, is VACUOUS for Prop 4.3 -- it is closed by tt/ff independent of phi. A non-vacuous Prop 4.3 requires the uniform model-independent translate, which is what the three blockers above gate.
